issue.title: dmx: export_binary writes stub element references without their UUID, corrupting the file

findings.detail: Source uses submodules. Their availability and exact revisions need a separate dependency check. Resolved for this revision: The focused pure-Python DMX regression does not import or build the optional C sources in the repository submodule.

resolution.reason: The focused pure-Python DMX regression does not import or build the optional C sources in the repository submodule.
evidence: PYTHONPATH=src pytest executes test_export_bin_stub_roundtrip with the Python implementation.
The changed files are src/srctools/dmx.py and tests/test_dmx.py only.

nextActions: Review the reported behavior and build instructions; define the baseline failure before cloning or scheduling a build.
limitations: READY_TO_INVESTIGATE means metadata is sufficient to begin engineering review, not a reproduced or repaired bug.

dimensions.reason: The parsed stub must retain the exact UUID.
evidence: Binary parser explicitly expects a null-terminated UUID after marker -2.

dimensions.reason: A deterministic in-memory export/import test fails at EOF.

evidence: No SFM installation or hardware is required for binary correctness.

dimensions.reason: The new bytes are exactly what the existing parser already consumes.
evidence: Round trip asserts format metadata, stub type and UUID.

dimensions.reason: Any DMX tree with external element references benefits.
evidence: The logic is shared by all binary export versions.

dimensions.reason: The fix applies to scalar and array element attributes.
All callers exporting binary DMX gain a valid stream.
